name: beethoven-desktop
description: Start, watch and stop your Claude Code worker on your university's grid, and read its workspace, over your own ssh sign-in.
long_description:
Beethoven reaches the Claude Code worker that runs as a batch job on your university's grid. You sign in to the grid yourself, in a terminal window, in ssh's own prompt: Beethoven never sees your grid password or one-time code, and it never holds a Claude credential. Its tools then start the worker through your lab's shared copy of the worker tool, read its status at most once a minute, show its progress log and its workspace, stop it, and open its Claude Code link in your browser. There is no tool that runs a command of the model's choosing on the grid.

Beethoven runs Claude Code and is not an Anthropic product; "Claude" and "Claude Code" are Anthropic's marks, used here to say what it runs; "Open OnDemand" is the mark of its publisher.

tools.name: grid_sign_in
tools.description: Opens a terminal window where you sign in to the grid with ssh; Beethoven never sees what you type.

tools.name: grid_sign_out
tools.description: Ends the sign-in Beethoven keeps on this computer; the worker keeps running.

tools.name: grid_check
tools.description: Whether you are signed in, the grid account, and the lab's worker tool version.

tools.name: worker_status
tools.description: Where your worker is: in line, starting, online with its Claude link, stopped.

tools.name: worker_list
tools.description: Every worker under your grid account, whoever started it, and the Claude account each one uses.

tools.name: worker_start
tools.description: Asks the grid for your worker through the lab's shared worker tool.

tools.name: worker_stop
tools.description: Stops your worker; nothing is deleted.

tools.name: worker_log
tools.description: The last lines of your worker's progress log.

tools.name: workspace_list
tools.description: Lists a folder of your worker's workspace.

tools.name: workspace_read
tools.description: Reads a text file of your worker's workspace; credentials are never shown.

tools.name: account_list
tools.description: Your own Claude accounts on this computer, as the account switcher keeps them, with their last usage readings.

tools.name: open_in_claude
tools.description: Opens your worker's Claude Code link in your browser.

grid_account.title: Your grid account name
grid_account.description: The name you sign in to the grid with (at Wayne State, your AccessID, like ab1234). Not a password: Beethoven never asks for one.

site.title: Your university's grid
site.description: The site profile: wayne is Wayne State's grid.

worker_name.title: Worker name
worker_name.description: Which of your workers the tools use when you don't name one.

use_wsl.title: Use WSL's ssh (Windows only)
use_wsl.description: Windows' own ssh can't keep one sign-in for every request, so with a grid password and code you sign in again each time. WSL's ssh can keep it. Needs WSL with a Linux distribution that has the OpenSSH client.
